verdict.rationale: Neon is explicitly documented as real, open-source Postgres (not a compatible-only layer), connectable via standard clients (psql, dbeaver) and supporting genuine Postgres extensions like pgvector, and community users note it preserves 'Postgres features' unlike moving to non-Postgres systems. missing for 10: a broader documented extension compatibility list beyond pgvector and independent third-party compatibility/regression testing against vanilla Postgres.
